title: Smallest String With Swaps
summary: Given a string and a list of index pairs, you can swap characters at these pairs any number of times.
statement: Given a string and a list of index pairs, you can swap characters at these pairs any number of times. Return the lexicographically smallest string possible after performing these swaps.
constraints: Each pair allows its two indices to swap any number of times.
Swaps compose transitively within connected index components.
Return the lexicographically smallest reachable string.
hints: Connected swap indices can realize any permutation of their characters.
Union paired indices and collect characters by component root.
Sort each component’s characters and consume its smallest at indices from left to right.
Independent component sorting minimizes the earliest possible character at every output position.
editorial: Independent component sorting minimizes the earliest possible character at every output position.

tests.explanation: Sorting characters inside the two components produces bacd.
All indices connect, so the globally sorted string abcd is reachable.
